candidates.label: Creation producing both disbeliever and believer under divine sight
candidates.definition: In 64:2: It is He who created you and among you is the disbeliever and among you is the believer; and Allah of what you do is Seeing.

evidence.excerpt: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ فَمِنكُمۡ كَافِرٞ وَمِنكُم مُّؤۡمِنٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Earlier disbelievers rejecting human messengers and tasting consequences
candidates.definition: In 64:5-6: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair and they will have a painful punishment; that is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences but they said shall human beings guide us and disbelieved and turned away.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ فَذَاقُواْ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهِمۡ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٞ يَهۡدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُواْ وَتَوَلَّواْۖ وَّٱسۡتَغۡنَى ٱللَّهُۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Resurrection affirmed by oath and declared easy for Allah
candidates.definition: In 64:7: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected; say yes by my Lord you will surely be resurrected then you will surely be informed of what you did and that for Allah is easy.

evidence.excerpt: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَن لَّن يُبۡعَثُواْۚ قُلۡ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتُبۡعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلۡتُمۡۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Day of Assembly named the Day of Deprivation (Taghabun)
candidates.definition: In 64:9: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly, that is the Day of Deprivation.

evidence.excerpt: يَوۡمَ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡجَمۡعِۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: No disaster striking except by Allah's permission with heart-guidance for believers
candidates.definition: In 64:11: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah; and whoever believes in Allah He will guide his heart; and Allah is Knowing of all things.

evidence.excerpt: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِ قَلۡبَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Messenger's duty limited to clear notification when people turn away
candidates.definition: In 64:12: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away then upon Our Messenger is only the duty of clear notification.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Wives and children as potential enemies with pardon urged
candidates.definition: In 64:14: O you who have believed indeed among your wives and your children are enemies to you so beware of them; but if you pardon and overlook and forgive then indeed Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدِكُمۡ عَدُوّٗا لَّكُمۡ فَٱحۡذَرُوهُمۡۚ وَإِن تَعۡفُواْ وَتَصۡفَحُواْ وَتَغۡفِرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Wealth and children as trial against great reward
candidates.definition: In 64:15: Your wealth and your children are but a trial and Allah has with Him a great reward.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Capacity-based taqwa with success for guarding against soul-stinginess
candidates.definition: In 64:16: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend; it is better for your selves; and whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul it is those who will be the successful.

evidence.excerpt: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ وَٱسۡمَعُواْ وَأَطِيعُواْ وَأَنفِقُواْ خَيۡرٗا لِّأَنفُسِكُمۡۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفۡسِهِۦ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Goodly loan multiplied and forgiven by the Most Appreciative and Forbearing
candidates.definition: In 64:17: If you loan Allah a goodly loan He will multiply it for you and forgive you; and Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.

evidence.excerpt: إِن تُقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا يُضَٰعِفۡهُ لَكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
